_source: Ministry of Education / Curriculum Development Centre, Zambia — Civic Education Scheme of Work, Form 2, Terms 1-3 (2026), as prepared by a serving teacher against the official CDC Civic Education syllabus (each entry cites the syllabus page it is drawn from, e.g. 'Syllabus p.34'). No separate full syllabus document (with numbered Topic/Sub-topic/Specific-Competence text independent of a term's pacing) was available for this subject/form at ingestion time, so topic, sub-topic, competency and learning-objective text is reconstructed from the scheme of work's own Topic/Subtopic/Specific Competence/Content/Learning Activities/Expected Standards columns — the scheme's own competency codes (2.1.1.1 etc.) are reproduced as found. The source document's teacher name, TS number and school name have been removed — this file contains no identifying information about who prepared the source scheme, per this app's standing content policy of crediting only CDC/Ministry of Education. Three weeks per term (Revision & Reporting, Mid-Term Test, Revision & Integration, End-of-Term Test) carry no new topic content and are omitted here. Two topics (2.1 Constitution's 'The Zambian Constitution' sub-topic, 2.2 Elections' 'Elections' sub-topic, 2.2's 'Electoral Commission of Zambia' sub-topic, and 2.12 Business Plan's final sub-topic) each span two consecutive weeks under one sub-topic name with two distinct competency codes — both competencies are kept under that single sub-topic rather than split, matching how the source scheme presents them.

subject.name: Civic Education
subject.description: Ordinary Level Secondary Civic Education syllabus, Form 1-4 (Curriculum Development Centre).

grade.name: Form 2
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 2" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

sub_topics.name: 2.1.1 The Constitution
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: understanding of the Constitution demonstrated accordingly.

learning_objectives.description: Discussing the Constitution
Describing its characteristics
Examining forms and types
Analysing advantages and disadvantages of each form

sub_topics.name: 2.1.2 The Zambian Constitution
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: Constitution-making and adoption process analysed accordingly; structure of the Constitution examined accordingly.

competencies.description: Analyse process of Constitution making and adoption in Zambia

learning_objectives.description: Describing history of Constitution making in Zambia (Chona, Mvunga, Mwanakatwe, Wila Mung'omba, Zambia Constitution Review Commissions)
Analysing the Constitution adoption process (Parliament, Referendum, Constituent Assembly)
Examining the structure of the Zambian Constitution (Parts and Articles)

sub_topics.name: 2.1.3 Importance of Constitution
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: importance of Constitution explained accordingly.

learning_objectives.description: Explaining the importance of the Constitution (promotes and protects the rule of law; owned and guarded by citizens; ensures democratic governance)

sub_topics.name: 2.2.1 Elections
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: significance of electing leaders justified accordingly; types and forms of elections classified accordingly.

competencies.description: Classify types and forms of elections

learning_objectives.description: Assessing the significance of electing leaders in any organisation
Explaining meaning and importance of elections
Describing characteristics of a credible election
Classifying types of elections (Presidential, National Assembly, Local Government)
Analysing forms of elections (General and By-elections)

sub_topics.name: 2.2.2 Electoral Commission of Zambia (ECZ)
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: role of ECZ analysed accordingly; electoral malpractice analysed accordingly.

competencies.description: Analyse the role of the Electoral Commission of Zambia (ECZ)

learning_objectives.description: Describing the role of the ECZ (organise, conduct and manage elections) and discussing the Electoral Process (legislation, delimitation, voter education, registration)
Describing the Electoral Code of Conduct and discussing voters' rights
Analysing forms of electoral malpractice

sub_topics.name: 2.2.3 Electoral Systems
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: electoral systems examined accordingly.

learning_objectives.description: Examining electoral systems (Single Member Plurality/Winner Takes It All, Majoritarian, Proportional Representation, Mixed Member Proportionality)
Explaining Zambia's electoral system

sub_topics.name: 2.3.1 The concept of Economic and Social Development
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: solutions to life challenges devised accordingly.

competencies.description: Devise solutions in dealing with life challenges

learning_objectives.description: Exploring life challenges (social and economic)
Explaining the concept of Economic and Social Development
Discussing human needs (food, shelter, clothes, water)
Describing factors affecting production (land, capital, labour, enterprise)
Explaining importance of standards

sub_topics.name: 2.3.2 The role of Informal Sector to National Development
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: role of Informal Sector demonstrated accordingly.

competencies.description: Demonstrate understanding of the role of Informal Sector to National Development

learning_objectives.description: Analysing the role of the Informal Sector to National Development (creation of employment; production of goods and services)

sub_topics.name: 2.4.1 Local and International Trade
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: local and international trade differentiated accordingly.

competencies.description: Differentiate between local and international trade

learning_objectives.description: Classifying types of trade (local and international; visible and invisible)
Identifying challenges associated with local and international trade (poor transport, communication, smuggling)
Describing importance of trade
Discussing terms of trade (favourable/unfavourable balance of trade, balance of payments)
Analysing functions of the World Trade Organisation (WTO)
Designing a model on the chain of distribution

sub_topics.name: 2.5.1 History of Human Rights
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: human dignity promoted accordingly.

learning_objectives.description: Discussing Human Rights (claims and entitlements)
Describing historical development of Human Rights (Magna Carta, Charter of Man, UDHR)
Outlining significance of human dignity

sub_topics.name: 2.5.2 Categories of Human Rights
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: categories of Human Rights examined accordingly.

learning_objectives.description: Describing characteristics of Human Rights (inherent, inalienable, universal)
Explaining categories of Human Rights (civic and political rights; economic, social and cultural rights)
Dramatising a human rights violation at home (right to education)

sub_topics.name: 2.5.3 The Bill of Rights
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: concept of Bill of Rights examined accordingly.

competencies.description: Examine concept of Bill of Rights

learning_objectives.description: Explaining meaning of the Bill of Rights
Outlining elements of the Bill of Rights
Analysing limitations of the Bill of Rights
Demonstrating enforcement of the Bill of Rights

sub_topics.name: 2.6.1 Culture of Peace
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: peace and non-violence promoted accordingly.

competencies.description: Promote peace and non-violence in society

learning_objectives.description: Identifying factors that hinder peace (bullying, violating rules, greed)
Exploring culture of peace
Discussing ways of promoting peace (intermarriages, mutual respect, justice)
Promoting peace in different situations (family, classroom, school)

sub_topics.name: 2.6.2 Conflict in society
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: conflict in society resolved accordingly.

learning_objectives.description: Describing levels of conflict (individual, community, national, international)
Analysing causes of conflict (poverty, injustice, mineral exploration)
Discussing effects of conflict in society
Describing conflict resolution methods (counselling, mitigation, negotiation)

sub_topics.name: 2.6.3 Role of the United Nations in promoting peace
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: role of the UN in promoting peace examined accordingly.

competencies.description: Examine the role of United Nations in promoting peace

learning_objectives.description: Discussing the role of the United Nations in promoting peace (peacekeeping, conflict resolution)

sub_topics.name: 2.7.1 Regional Organisations
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: roles of Regional Organisations analysed accordingly.

learning_objectives.description: Identifying Regional Organisations to which Zambia is a member (SADC, COMESA, AU)
Describing the organisations and evaluating their structure
Discussing benefits of Zambia's membership (ease of trade)

sub_topics.name: 2.8.1 International Organisations
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: existence of International Organisations justified accordingly.

learning_objectives.description: Identifying International Organisations to which Zambia is a member (Commonwealth, United Nations)
Describing membership and structure of International Organisations
Discussing functions of International Organisations

sub_topics.name: 2.8.2 Specialised Agencies of the United Nations
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: understanding of Specialised Agencies of the UN demonstrated accordingly.

competencies.description: Demonstrate understanding of Specialised Agencies of the United Nations Organisations

learning_objectives.description: Describing Specialised Agencies of the United Nations (UNESCO, UNICEF, WHO, FAO)

sub_topics.name: 2.9.1 Borrowing
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: terms and conditions of borrowing interpreted accordingly.

competencies.description: Interpret terms and conditions of borrowing

learning_objectives.description: Identifying types of loans (personal, business, salary advance, agricultural, construction, asset financing)
Describing sources of borrowing (banks and micro-finance institutions)
Analysing reasons for borrowing
Filling in a loan application form

sub_topics.name: 2.9.2 Investment
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: knowledge of investment applied accordingly.

competencies.description: Apply knowledge of investment in real life

learning_objectives.description: Identifying types of investment (bond, real estate, stock)
Showing importance of investment and evaluating types of investment
Identifying investment opportunities

sub_topics.name: 2.10.1 The Concept of Taxation
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: tax paid accordingly.

learning_objectives.description: Showing significance of paying tax
Identifying taxation laws in Zambia and explaining the role of the Zambia Revenue Authority (ZRA)
Describing types of taxes (Pay As You Earn, Value Added Tax)
Understanding benefits of tax compliance and consequences of not paying tax

sub_topics.name: 2.11.1 Financial Services offered by Commercial Banks
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: banking and financial services used accordingly.

learning_objectives.description: Identifying regulation of commercial banks
Explaining documents used in banking (deposit slip, withdraw slip, invoice)
Justifying importance of commercial banks
Utilising e-banking services (bank transfer, e-banking, mobile banking)

sub_topics.name: 2.12.1 Business Idea
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: investment opportunities evaluated and business ideas generated accordingly.

competencies.description: Evaluate different investment opportunities and generate business ideas

learning_objectives.description: Identifying sources of a business idea and discussing business ideas
Brainstorming various business ideas
Selecting the best business idea by applying SWOT analysis (Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, Threats)

sub_topics.name: 2.12.2 Marketing Plan
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: marketing plan developed accordingly.

learning_objectives.description: Conducting market research
Making a marketing plan

sub_topics.name: 2.12.3 Financial Plan
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: financial plan prepared accordingly.

learning_objectives.description: Preparing a profit and loss statement
Preparing a cash flow plan

sub_topics.name: 2.12.4 Finalising a Business Plan; Business Startup Capital
sub_topics.description: Expected standard: business plan finalised and startup capital mobilised accordingly.

competencies.description: Consolidate components of a business plan

learning_objectives.description: Compiling a business plan
Identifying sources of startup capital
Sourcing startup capital
